IN THIS GUIDE

LifespanDiet & nutritionPersonalityHousing & enrichmentNoiseThe right match

Examples include: Blue-and-gold, scarlet, green-winged and Hahn’s macaws.

01

Lifespan & long-term planning

Large macaws can live for several decades. Smaller macaw species have different life expectations. Age, nutrition, health and husbandry all influence lifespan; plan for long-term care and a backup caregiver.

02

Diet & nutrition

Offer suitable formulated food with a varied selection of fresh vegetables and some fruit. Nuts can serve as measured rewards; the right amount depends on species, activity and veterinary advice.

03

Personality & temperament

Inquisitive, expressive birds that can enjoy social activity and positive-reinforcement training. Their strong beaks and size call for confident, respectful handling.

04

Housing & enrichment

Large species need substantial accommodation, strong perches and plenty of safe exercise space. Choose durable enrichment designed for a powerful beak.

05

Noise & vocalisation

Large macaws can produce very loud calls. Consider neighbours and the whole household before choosing one.

06

Is this group right for you?

Owners with the space, time and resources to meet a large parrot’s daily needs.
